description: This file implements the advanced operation functions of the Http Ato Header Object, including creating code and name tables for HTTP headers, and retrieving header codes and names by their identifiers. It defines functions for managing HTTP header atoms, such as 'HttpAtoHeaderCreateCodeTable', 'HttpAtoHeaderCreateNameTable', 'HttpAtoHeaderGetAtomCode', and 'HttpAtoHeaderGetAtomName'.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpAtoHeaderCreateCodeTable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Creates a table of atom codes for common HTTP headers by adding each header name with its corresponding ID to the internal table.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpAtoHeaderCreateNameTable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Creates a table of header names indexed by their atom IDs, allowing lookup of header names based on code.

methods.name: ULONG HttpAtoHeaderGetAtomCode(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * name)
methods.description: Retrieves the header code (ID) for a given header name by searching in the atom table.

methods.name: char * HttpAtoHeaderGetAtomName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG code)
methods.description: Retrieves the header name for a given header code (ID) from the atom table.
